SELECT WFL.TRADE_ID tradeId, FINTP.BRANCH branch, PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, SFPA1.ACCT_NO dealAcct, SFPA2.ACCT_NO corAcct FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WFL LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WFL2 ON WFL.FINPROD_ID = WFL2.FINPROD_ID AND WFL2.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' AND WFL2.PS != #{psBuy} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WFL3 ON WFL.FINPROD_ID = WFL3.FINPROD_ID AND WFL3.PS != #{psBuy} LEFT JOIN SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK SDPM ON NOT EXISTS (select 1 from SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK SDPM2 where SDPM2.BUSINESS_DATA_PK5 = SDPM.BUSINESS_DATA_PK5 and SDPM2.BUSINESS_DATA_PK4 = 'Y' and SDPM2.HIS_NO > SDPM.HIS_NO) AND WFL.FINPROD_ID = SDPM.BUSINESS_DATA_PK5 AND SDPM.BUSINESS_DATA_PK4 = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WFLDEAL ON WFL.TRADE_ID = WFLDEAL.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FINTP ON WFL.TRADE_ID = FINTP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON NVL(WFL.P_TRADE_ID,WFL.TRADE_ID) = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PTL ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA1 ON SFPA1.FINPROD_ID = WFL.FINPROD_ID AND SFPA1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2F12} AND SFPA1.ACCT_TYPE = #{ASSET_ACCT_TYPE_01} LEFT JOIN STL_FIN_PRODUCT_ACCT SFPA2 ON SFPA2.FINPROD_ID = WFL.FINPROD_ID AND SFPA2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2F12} AND SFPA2.ACCT_TYPE = #{ASSET_ACCT_TYPE_02}
PTL.INVEST_YESORNO='Y' AND WFL.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{finprodType2F12}, #{finprodType2F13}) AND WFL.PS = #{psBuy} AND WFL.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' AND WFL.TRADE_STATUS =#{validStatus_01} AND WFL.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' AND WFL2.FINPROD_ID IS NULL AND WFL3.FINPROD_ID IS NULL
AND FINTP.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{mdateBegin},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND FINTP.MDATE <= TO_DATE(#{mdateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND WFLDEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
AND (SDPM.STATUS IS NULL OR SDPM.STATUS NOT IN (#{STATUS_A}, #{STATUS_P}))
